messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

output:
Details are placeholders in brackets — swap in your specifics.

---

**Subject: [Service Name] is moving to [New Platform] in Q[N]**

Hi [Name],

Starting [Migration Date], [Service Name] will run on [New Platform] instead of [Current Platform]. We wanted you to hear it early, with enough lead time to plan around it.

Why now? [Current Platform] hasn't kept up with what customers are asking for — [specific limitation, e.g. "exports cap out at 10,000 rows" or "no single sign-on"]. Rebuilding those on the old stack would have taken most of a year. On [New Platform] they ship in [timeframe].

What changes for you:

- **Your login and data carry over.** Nothing to re-enter, no new account.
- **The URL changes** from [old URL] to [new URL] on [date]. Old links redirect for [duration].
- **API integrations need an updated endpoint.** Migration guide: [link]. If you're on [API version], you have until [sunset date].
- **[Feature X] works differently.** [One sentence on the difference.]

What doesn't change: pricing, your contract terms, and your support contact.

The switchover happens [date and time, with timezone]. Expect roughly [duration] of downtime. We'll post live status at [status page URL].

If you have a custom integration, heavy API traffic, or anything unusual in your setup, reply to this email and we'll walk through your specific case before [date]. We'd rather spend an hour with you now than troubleshoot after the cutover.

Questions in the meantime: [support email] or [link to FAQ].

— [Name], [Title]

---

~250 words. If you tell me the actual service, platform, and dates, I'll fill it in and adjust the tone for your audience.
